name: BPL-DREAM-11
description: Welcome to BPL-DREAM 11, an interactive web application where users can select and manage cricket players for their dream team. Inspired by fantasy leagues, this project allows users to simulate player selection under coin-based limitations and enjoy a beautiful, responsive UI design.

paragraphs: Welcome to BPL-DREAM 11, an interactive web application where users can select and manage cricket players for their dream team. Inspired by fantasy leagues, this project allows users to simulate player selection under coin-based limitations and enjoy a beautiful, responsive UI design.
features: Player Selection: Users can select cricket players from a list of available players for their team.
Coin Management: A coin-based system controls users' ability to buy players.
Responsive Design: The app is fully responsive and matches the Figma design.
Remove Player Functionality: Users can remove players from their selected team.
Notification System: All user interactions (e.g., errors, success) are displayed via toast notifications.
